pk: Bavadipa laksninarayanan natva taTa naDvadidesikan Bavadipa praripsiteti sanBavitaviGnanan sisyapraBrtinaniti yojyan adipadena pracaya bahuvrihi pranano visesyan sanuciteti sanyagyogyetyarTa devataprananasya sanucitatve hetava– visisweswadevateti tatrayanagre vyaktan ‘adO’ ityuktya gurudevata-prananasya granTavayavatvan sucayati nule ‘natva’ ityuktavapi prakrswanatiraBipreteti ‘prananan’ ityuktan ‘devan’ ityasya krtyapratiteraha– atra deveti stutyarTad divyate karnani Ganpratyayanta iti Bava saniDanaceti ‘gitarTan’ iti gitapadasaniDanadityarTa gitanan ca venuBranaraBiksugitadirupenanekatvad ‘Bagavadgita’ iti visesanokti teneti gitapratipadyatvavisesanakaTanena sanucitatanacaswa iti pratipadyasya svavisayagranTarTava-boDasanpadakatvat pranatadevatEva tatsanpadanaheturiti Bava ‘vi’ ityupasargarTa– viseseneti tadvyanakti– sarvada sarvatnaneti nisesata ityarTa itivEsiswyaniti ‘visesanadvayena BavaBavarupetarasaDaranaDarnavatvanacaswe’ vakti Basyakara ityarTa ‘tena narayanaprananasya sanucitatanacaswe’ ityanusanga visiswadevataya eva viGnaviGatadO saktatvaditi Bava nanu Baktyadiprakarsayukta natiriswadevatayaneva Bavatiti prananasya sanucitatvopapadanaya iswata narayanasya kuto nokta? ityata aha– paranavEsnavasyeti
ck: pavatipa laksninarayanan natva tata natvatitesikan pavatipa praripsiteti sanpavitaviknanan sisyapraprtinaniti yocyan atipatena pracaya pahuvrihi pranano visesyan sanuciteti sanyakyokyetyarta tevataprananasya sanucitatve hetava– visistestatevateti tatrayanakre vyaktan ‘atO’ ityuktya kurutevata-prananasya krantavayavatvan sucayati nule ‘natva’ ityuktavapi prakrstanatirapipreteti ‘prananan’ ityuktan ‘tevan’ ityasya krtyapratiteraha– atra teveti stutyartat tivyate karnani kanpratyayanta iti pava sanitanaceti ‘kitartan’ iti kitapatasanitanatityarta kitanan ca venupranarapiksukitatirupenanekatvat ‘pakavatkita’ iti visesanokti teneti kitapratipatyatvavisesanakatanena sanucitatanacasta iti pratipatyasya svavisayakrantartava-potasanpatakatvat pranatatevatEva tatsanpatanaheturiti pava ‘vi’ ityupasarkarta– viseseneti tatvyanakti– sarvata sarvatnaneti nisesata ityarta itivEsistyaniti ‘visesanatvayena pavapavarupetarasataranatarnavatvanacaste’ vakti pasyakara ityarta ‘tena narayanaprananasya sanucitatanacaste’ ityanusanka visistatevataya eva viknavikatatO saktatvatiti pava nanu paktyatiprakarsayukta natiristatevatayaneva pavatiti prananasya sanucitatvopapatanaya istata narayanasya kuto nokta? ityata aha– paranavEsnavasyeti
s: भावदीपः लक्ष्मीनारायणं नत्वा तथा मध्वादिदेशिकान् भावदीपः प्रारिप्सितेति सम्भावितविघ्नानां शिष्यप्रभृतीनामिति योज्यम् आदिपदेन प्रचयः बहुव्रीह

pk: Bavadipa DarnaDarnavisayatvanatreneti natrapadena vastavaDarnaDarnavisayatvan vyavartyate tatveti budDinadvadatvaprasangadityarTa tenapi ‘cEtyavandanadi DarnonyoDarna’ ityupadesakaranaditi Bava punarvEyarTyaditi sarvasyapi vadasya prajnapurvakatvaniva svaprajnapurvakatvasyapi sidDatvena ‘svaprajnavadan’ ityasyapi vEyarTyaneva atovaDaranan vivaksaniyanityarTa (vEyarTyaniti savaDaranan) ‘kaTanasocya’ iti prasnasya sesoktyarTanaha– asane-tyadina asyotaran– gatasuniti Basye pratikagrahanenoktanutararDan tadarTastutara-slokavatarikayan vaksyati vakyavrti vakyasTitirityarTa asidDasyeti asocyatvasya prajnavadatvasya cetyarTa sidDasyeti ‘socani’ ityadina purvatra sokasya, ‘arjuna uvaca’ iti Basanasya ca prastutatvaditi Bava 1
ck: pavatipa tarnatarnavisayatvanatreneti natrapatena vastavatarnatarnavisayatvan vyavartyate tatveti putinatvatatvaprasankatityarta tenapi ‘cEtyavantanati tarnonyotarna’ ityupatesakaranatiti pava punarvEyartyatiti sarvasyapi vatasya pracnapurvakatvaniva svapracnapurvakatvasyapi sitatvena ‘svapracnavatan’ ityasyapi vEyartyaneva atovataranan vivaksaniyanityarta (vEyartyaniti savataranan) ‘katanasocya’ iti prasnasya sesoktyartanaha– asane-tyatina asyotaran– katasuniti pasye pratikakrahanenoktanutarartan tatartastutara-slokavatarikayan vaksyati vakyavrti vakyastitirityarta asitasyeti asocyatvasya pracnavatatvasya cetyarta sitasyeti ‘socani’ ityatina purvatra sokasya, ‘arcuna uvaca’ iti pasanasya ca prastutatvatiti pava 1
s: भावदीपः धर्माधर्मविषयत्वमात्रेणेति मात्रपदेन वास्तवधर्माधर्मविषयत्वं व्यावर्त्यते तत्त्वेति बुद्धिमद्वादत्वप्रसङ्गादित्यर्थः तेनापि ‘चैत्यवन

pk: Bavadipa purvanutararDasyarTanukte ‘kiniti’ iti nulanuvadena tadarToktipurvan ‘gatasun’ iti Basyasya sesoktyarTanaha– kinitityadina atreti ‘na tvevahan’ ityata purvan Basye ityarTa yaTasrutEveti krsnasyapi nityatvoktiparatayEvetyarTa nanvasninpakse jivanityatve drswanto nokta syadityata aha– drswantastutaratreti ‘dehinosnin’ iti slokavyaKyanavasare ‘yaTa kOnaradi’ ityadiBasye kOnarayuvadidehaBedepi tadehasTa ekasidDa, evananekadeha-praptavapi sarvadehagonadinitya sidDa iti vaksyananatvaditi Bava yadva ‘nasata’ iti sloke ‘prakrtyade’ iti nityatokteriti Bava ata eveti avivadadyotanarTatvadevetyarTa
ck: pavatipa purvanutarartasyartanukte ‘kiniti’ iti nulanuvatena tatartoktipurvan ‘katasun’ iti pasyasya sesoktyartanaha– kinitityatina atreti ‘na tvevahan’ ityata purvan pasye ityarta yatasrutEveti krsnasyapi nityatvoktiparatayEvetyarta nanvasninpakse civanityatve trstanto nokta syatityata aha– trstantastutaratreti ‘tehinosnin’ iti slokavyakyanavasare ‘yata kOnarati’ ityatipasye kOnarayuvatitehapetepi tatehasta ekasita, evananekateha-praptavapi sarvatehakonatinitya sita iti vaksyananatvatiti pava yatva ‘nasata’ iti sloke ‘prakrtyate’ iti nityatokteriti pava ata eveti avivatatyotanartatvatevetyarta
s: भावदीपः पूर्वमुत्तरार्धस्यार्थानुक्तेः ‘किमिति’ इति मूलानुवादेन तदर्थोक्तिपूर्वं ‘गतासून्’ इति भाष्यस्य शेषोक्त्याऽर्थमाह– किमितीत्यादिना अत

pk: Bavadipa ‘tat’ ityanuvada, ‘dehatiriktatnasatvan’ iti vyaKya ‘asrayasidDiriti’ ityanantaran ‘ityeka sanka’ iti sesa tadeva vakyananyaTa yojayati– astu veti tantra-niti vivaksitatvenopatanityarTa (vivaksitarTajnapakatvena iti Bavyaniti Bati) purvotareti tadiyatvenaBinatapurvotaradehesvityarTa ‘etat’ ityanuvada,‘anunanan’ iti vyaKya ‘saDyata iti’ ityanantaran ‘aByaDikasanka’ iti sesa yojanadvaye jnapaka-nyaha– taduBayasyapiti ‘dehina’ iti sloke Basyaritya sankadvayapariharadarsanadityarTa bahuvacana iti purvaslokasyotararDe
ck: pavatipa ‘tat’ ityanuvata, ‘tehatiriktatnasatvan’ iti vyakya ‘asrayasitiriti’ ityanantaran ‘ityeka sanka’ iti sesa tateva vakyananyata yocayati– astu veti tantra-niti vivaksitatvenopatanityarta (vivaksitartacnapakatvena iti pavyaniti pati) purvotareti tatiyatvenapinatapurvotaratehesvityarta ‘etat’ ityanuvata,‘anunanan’ iti vyakya ‘satyata iti’ ityanantaran ‘apyatikasanka’ iti sesa yocanatvaye cnapaka-nyaha– tatupayasyapiti ‘tehina’ iti sloke pasyaritya sankatvayapariharatarsanatityarta pahuvacana iti purvaslokasyotararte
s: भावदीपः ‘तत्’ इत्यनुवादः, ‘देहातिरिक्तात्मसत्त्वम्’ इति व्याख्या ‘आश्रयासिद्धिरिति’ इत्यनन्तरम् ‘इत्येका शङ्का’ इति शेषः तदेव वाक्यमन्यथा यो

pk: Bavadipa visayaviseseti sparsarupavisayavisesetyarTa kasca pratisanbanDiti natrasparsa-sabditavisayasanbanDanan pratisanbanDi ka ityarTa aneneti deha ityadiBasyenetyarTa sakaleti ‘sitosna’ ityukteriti Bava ‘anuBava’ ityuktilabDanaha– tatsaksatkara iti laksitalaksaneyaniti visayavisesavacisitosnasabdaByan rupadisakalavisayalaksana-dvara tadanuBavasya laksanayopapadanaditi Bava evan Basyan vyaKyaya ‘natra’ iti nule purvarDarTanaha– eteneti ‘natrasparsa’ ityarDena kaTananudyate? ityata aha– tata-dvisayananiti
ck: pavatipa visayaviseseti sparsarupavisayavisesetyarta kasca pratisanpantiti natrasparsa-saptitavisayasanpantanan pratisanpanti ka ityarta aneneti teha ityatipasyenetyarta sakaleti ‘sitosna’ ityukteriti pava ‘anupava’ ityuktilaptanaha– tatsaksatkara iti laksitalaksaneyaniti visayavisesavacisitosnasaptapyan rupatisakalavisayalaksana-tvara tatanupavasya laksanayopapatanatiti pava evan pasyan vyakyaya ‘natra’ iti nule purvartartanaha– eteneti ‘natrasparsa’ ityartena katananutyate? ityata aha– tata-tvisayananiti

s: भावदीपः एवंविधानामिति अभिमानहीनानामित्यर्थः श्रवणात् बृहदारण्यक इति भावः पूर्वकक्ष्येति अभिमानत्यागात् पूर्वकक्ष्यास्थत्वसमदुःखसुखत्वादेः तद

pk: Bavadipa yan pratiti ‘pakse niksipta’ iti viBagena yojyan yasya purusasya krsnepi nityatva-sandeha ityarTa utararDavyavrtyokti– dvitiyastviti nanu krsnadisarvacetanan nitya-nanaditvat ityatranvayavyaptO drswantaBavepi vyatirekavyaptO drswanto Gawadirastyeveti drswantasidDyarTan prakrtyadernityatvoktirgitayanayukteti hrdyasankya gitaBiprayanaha– sidDantiti gitakara ityarTa ukteti aprananikatvaBiprayenetyarTa brahneti BasyasTabrahnasabdoktanityarTa anaditvepiti ‘sadeva sOnyedanagre’(Can.u.6.2.1), ‘brahna va idanagra asit’ (br.u.3.5.4) ityadiragana ityarTa evan prakrteranaditvepi ‘ajanekan lohitasuklakrsnan’ (tE.a.10.10.1), ‘gOranadyantavati, ButaBavana sitasita ca rakta ca’ ityadiragana ityarTa anekadrswanteti gitayan prakrtyadyaneketyarTa
ck: pavatipa yan pratiti ‘pakse niksipta’ iti vipakena yocyan yasya purusasya krsnepi nityatva-santeha ityarta utarartavyavrtyokti– tvitiyastviti nanu krsnatisarvacetanan nitya-nanatitvat ityatranvayavyaptO trstantapavepi vyatirekavyaptO trstanto katatirastyeveti trstantasityartan prakrtyaternityatvoktirkitayanayukteti hrtyasankya kitapiprayanaha– sitantiti kitakara ityarta ukteti aprananikatvapiprayenetyarta prahneti pasyastaprahnasaptoktanityarta anatitvepiti ‘sateva sOnyetanakre’(can.u.6.2.1), ‘prahna va itanakra asit’ (pr.u.3.5.4) ityatirakana ityarta evan prakrteranatitvepi ‘acanekan lohitasuklakrsnan’ (tE.a.10.10.1), ‘kOranatyantavati, putapavana sitasita ca rakta ca’ ityatirakana ityarta anekatrstanteti kitayan prakrtyatyaneketyarta
s: भावदीपः यं प्रतीति ‘पक्षे निक्षिप्तः’ इति विभागेन योज्यम् यस्य पुरुषस्य कृष्णेऽपि नित्यत्व-सन्देह इत्यर्थः उत्तरार्धव्यावृत्त्योक्तिः– द्वित

pk: Bavadipa vakyananiti ‘prakrti purusa’ (gi.Ba.16 uda.vi.pu.va.) ‘sadeva sonya’ityadi brahnadiboDakavakyananityarTa anunanasyeti cetananityatvanunanasya ‘natvevahan’ (2.12) ityatroktasyetyarTa pratyaBijnanadineti ‘tadevedan vacananiti pratyaBijnanat’ (vi.ta.ni. pra.pari) iti tatvanirnayokteriti Bava ‘yavadbrahna visWitan tavati vak’, ‘anadirva ayanakasa’ ityadiradipadarTa tacCiliketi ‘supyajatO nini tacCilye’ (pa.su.3.2.78) iti sopasargasyapi nase tacCilikaCandasaninipratyaye vinasiti sidDeriti Bava 17
ck: pavatipa vakyananiti ‘prakrti purusa’ (ki.pa.16 uta.vi.pu.va.) ‘sateva sonya’ityati prahnatipotakavakyananityarta anunanasyeti cetananityatvanunanasya ‘natvevahan’ (2.12) ityatroktasyetyarta pratyapicnanatineti ‘tatevetan vacananiti pratyapicnanat’ (vi.ta.ni. pra.pari) iti tatvanirnayokteriti pava ‘yavatprahna vistitan tavati vak’, ‘anatirva ayanakasa’ ityatiratipatarta taciliketi ‘supyacatO nini tacilye’ (pa.su.3.2.78) iti sopasarkasyapi nase tacilikacantasaninipratyaye vinasiti siteriti pava 17
s: भावदीपः वाक्यानामिति ‘प्रकृतिः पुरुषः’ (गी.भा.१६ उदा.वि.पु.व.) ‘सदेव सोम्य’इत्यादि ब्रह्मादिबोधकवाक्यानामित्यर्थः अनुमानस्येति चेतननित्यत्वा

pk: Bavadipa praguktaniti ‘dehinosnin’ (2.13) ityatra pratipaksaniti pratibinbatna na nitya anityopaDikatvat darpanopaDikapratibinbavat ityevan pratipaksan vaktunityarTa sidDarTa-teti ‘antavanta ine deha’ ityukte sidDarTatvapariharaya kasyacidapi tvaya sankitasya nastiti vaktun prasne ‘kasyacit’ iti visesanoktirityarTa nanvatnano nityatve tadupaDi-Butadehananapi nityatvan syadityatiprasangoktiparanidan vakyan anyaTa prasnarTakatve ‘Bavatu’ iti na syat; ‘Bavati’ ityeva syaditi sankate– nanviti vakyavrti gitavakyasya vrtirityarTa kuto ‘nityasya’ ityasya viDeyaparata? ityata aha– anuvada iti vyaktakarisyata iti ‘nityascopaDi’ ityadavetadupaDidvEviDyaniti Bava
ck: pavatipa prakuktaniti ‘tehinosnin’ (2.13) ityatra pratipaksaniti pratipinpatna na nitya anityopatikatvat tarpanopatikapratipinpavat ityevan pratipaksan vaktunityarta sitarta-teti ‘antavanta ine teha’ ityukte sitartatvapariharaya kasyacitapi tvaya sankitasya nastiti vaktun prasne ‘kasyacit’ iti visesanoktirityarta nanvatnano nityatve tatupati-putatehananapi nityatvan syatityatiprasankoktiparanitan vakyan anyata prasnartakatve ‘pavatu’ iti na syat; ‘pavati’ ityeva syatiti sankate– nanviti vakyavrti kitavakyasya vrtirityarta kuto ‘nityasya’ ityasya viteyaparata? ityata aha– anuvata iti vyaktakarisyata iti ‘nityascopati’ ityatavetatupatitvEvityaniti pava
s: भावदीपः प्रागुक्तमिति ‘देहिनोऽस्मिन्’ (२.१३) इत्यत्र प्रतिपक्षमिति प्रतिबिम्बात्मा न नित्यः अनित्योपाधिकत्वात् दर्पणोपाधिकप्रतिबिम्बवत् इत्य

pk: Bavadipa gitayan ‘na vijanita’ ityukte Basye ‘vyavaharastu’ ityukti kaTan? ityata aha– vyavahara iti svapaksasaDakananeveti jivanityatvasaDakanan binbasya nityatvat, upaDesca nityatvat, tatsaniDeranasaceti hetunanityarTa karaneti sastrena kuruksetra ityuktiprasangadityarTa kaTanceti ‘na hanyate’ ityetavaduktO ca hananabudDerBranatvokti-sanBavaditi Bava yaToktan tatparyanirnaya iti ‘gita’iti adO yojyan gitatatparye hi ‘yadyapi nityatvan jivasyapyasti taTapi sarvaprakarenavinasitvan visnoreva’ ityadina ‘tasnadanasinopraneyasya visno pujarTan yuDyasva’ ityantena granTena ‘aviniasi tu tadvidDi’ ityadislokarTataya isvarasya svatantryan jivasyasvatantryan coktanityarTa tatreti evan-satityarTa anena ‘ya enan’ iti slokena ucyate ya enan jivan svatantryena hantaran veti yascEnan jivan hatan nanyate tavuBO svatantryajnani jivahananajnani cetyuBO na vijanita Branti-nantO kuta? isvarapratibinbatvahetuna svatantryaBavat nayan svatantryena hanti binba-nityatvadipraguktahetuByo nityatvena na hanyate yasnadityevan rupenocyata iti heto ‘uBO’ ityadyupapadyata ityarTa
ck: pavatipa kitayan ‘na vicanita’ ityukte pasye ‘vyavaharastu’ ityukti katan? ityata aha– vyavahara iti svapaksasatakananeveti civanityatvasatakanan pinpasya nityatvat, upatesca nityatvat, tatsaniteranasaceti hetunanityarta karaneti sastrena kuruksetra ityuktiprasankatityarta katanceti ‘na hanyate’ ityetavatuktO ca hananaputerpranatvokti-sanpavatiti pava yatoktan tatparyanirnaya iti ‘kita’iti atO yocyan kitatatparye hi ‘yatyapi nityatvan civasyapyasti tatapi sarvaprakarenavinasitvan visnoreva’ ityatina ‘tasnatanasinopraneyasya visno pucartan yutyasva’ ityantena krantena ‘aviniasi tu tatviti’ ityatislokartataya isvarasya svatantryan civasyasvatantryan coktanityarta tatreti evan-satityarta anena ‘ya enan’ iti slokena ucyate ya enan civan svatantryena hantaran veti yascEnan civan hatan nanyate tavupO svatantryacnani civahananacnani cetyupO na vicanita pranti-nantO kuta? isvarapratipinpatvahetuna svatantryapavat nayan svatantryena hanti pinpa-nityatvatiprakuktahetupyo nityatvena na hanyate yasnatityevan rupenocyata iti heto ‘upO’ ityatyupapatyata ityarta
s: भावदीपः गीतायां ‘न विजानीतः’ इत्युक्तेः भाष्ये ‘व्यवहारस्तु’ इत्युक्तिः कथम्? इत्यत आह– व्यवहार इति स्वपक्षसाधकानामेवेति जीवनित्यत्वसाधकानां

pk: Bavadipa tadutara caturTa pada nanu ‘sarvaTa nasaBavana soka karya’ ityupasanhare isvara-sarupatvaKyapratibinbatvanatraneva vacyan isvarasanarTyokte kvopayoga? ityata sanka-nivartakatvenopayoganaha– isvarasarupatvepiti iti sankapariharahetutvadisvarasanarTyokteriti yojyan ascaryananitya ityadi snrtiniti purvanadrswatvenotaratra Bavitvena hetuna anityasabdalaksite adButerTe ascaryasabdo nipatyata iti sasWadyapadiyapaninisutrarTa anpurvacare yatpratyaya, suqaganascetyuktan vrtO aneneti ‘srutvapyenan’ ityupa-padanenetyarTa enan jivan isvarasarupatvadina ya pasyati vadati srnoti sa ascaryavad ascarya eva durlaBa ityarTa ityuktan Bavati kaTananenesvarasanarTyan darsitan? ityata aha– yatpratibinbasyeti ‘draswapi’ ityupalaksanan vakta srota cetyapi grahyan 29,30
ck: pavatipa tatutara caturta pata nanu ‘sarvata nasapavana soka karya’ ityupasanhare isvara-sarupatvakyapratipinpatvanatraneva vacyan isvarasanartyokte kvopayoka? ityata sanka-nivartakatvenopayokanaha– isvarasarupatvepiti iti sankapariharahetutvatisvarasanartyokteriti yocyan ascaryananitya ityati snrtiniti purvanatrstatvenotaratra pavitvena hetuna anityasaptalaksite atputerte ascaryasapto nipatyata iti sastatyapatiyapaninisutrarta anpurvacare yatpratyaya, sutakanascetyuktan vrtO aneneti ‘srutvapyenan’ ityupa-patanenetyarta enan civan isvarasarupatvatina ya pasyati vatati srnoti sa ascaryavat ascarya eva turlapa ityarta ityuktan pavati katananenesvarasanartyan tarsitan? ityata aha– yatpratipinpasyeti ‘trastapi’ ityupalaksanan vakta srota cetyapi krahyan 29,30
s: भावदीपः तदुत्तरः चतुर्थः पादः ननु ‘सर्वथा नाशाभावान्न शोकः कार्यः’ इत्युपसंहारे ईश्वर-सरूपत्वाख्यप्रतिबिम्बत्वमात्रमेव वाच्यम् ईश्वरसामर्थ्य

pk: Bavadipa catuslokati BasyakrdvyaKyata‘vyavasayatnika’ ityadi catuslokatyarTa anyaTa ‘neha’ ityaraBya pancaslokati vakyan syat iti nandasanketi ‘yoge tvinan srnu’ (2.39) iti pratijnatanivrtakarnaKyajnanopaye nisWajananaya ‘neha’ iti slokena tatprasansakaranasya ca ‘vyavasaya’ ityadi slokacatuswayena natantaranindakaranasya nisWaheto purvaBavitvavasyanBavasya sPuwatvat nandasanka ityuktan tadevaha– svoktaviti ‘yoge tvinan srnu’ (2.39) iti svoktavityarTa evan ‘vyavasaya’ ityadislokoktaprakarene-tyarTa yogavirudDaniti nivrtakarnaKyajnanopayavirudDanityarTa vaksyatiti ‘saptana-Dyaye’ iti yojyan ‘praDanyena’ ityuktya anyasyapyapraDanasyokte sucanaditi Bava
ck: pavatipa catuslokati pasyakrtvyakyata‘vyavasayatnika’ ityati catuslokatyarta anyata ‘neha’ ityarapya pancaslokati vakyan syat iti nantasanketi ‘yoke tvinan srnu’ (2.39) iti praticnatanivrtakarnakyacnanopaye nistacananaya ‘neha’ iti slokena tatprasansakaranasya ca ‘vyavasaya’ ityati slokacatustayena natantaranintakaranasya nistaheto purvapavitvavasyanpavasya sputatvat nantasanka ityuktan tatevaha– svoktaviti ‘yoke tvinan srnu’ (2.39) iti svoktavityarta evan ‘vyavasaya’ ityatislokoktaprakarene-tyarta yokavirutaniti nivrtakarnakyacnanopayavirutanityarta vaksyatiti ‘saptana-tyaye’ iti yocyan ‘pratanyena’ ityuktya anyasyapyapratanasyokte sucanatiti pava

pk: Bavadipa purvenEveti ‘icCa ca tasya yukta’ ityadigranTenEvetyarTa ‘yata’ ityadyaganasatvepi tasya pratyekaneva yogavisesane vyavartake ityarTa idaniti ‘sanatvan yoga’ ityetadityarTa yadva– karna kurvato yogasTatvaniva sangatyagasanatvepi tasya visesane eva, na tu yoga-sabdarToktipare iti kalpayisyantiti nandanugrahecCayedanuktanityarTa tarhi sangatyagavisiswan sanatvaniti vacyanityata aha– yogEkadesa iti yadva– nivrtakarnana eva jnanopayatvena yogatvat tyagasanatvayo tadekadesatvat kaTan sanatvan? arTad grhita(sanga)tyagatvayoga ityuktirityato va BagavadBakterapi yogatvadva aha– yogEkadesa iti 48
ck: pavatipa purvenEveti ‘ica ca tasya yukta’ ityatikrantenEvetyarta ‘yata’ ityatyakanasatvepi tasya pratyekaneva yokavisesane vyavartake ityarta itaniti ‘sanatvan yoka’ ityetatityarta yatva– karna kurvato yokastatvaniva sankatyakasanatvepi tasya visesane eva, na tu yoka-saptartoktipare iti kalpayisyantiti nantanukrahecayetanuktanityarta tarhi sankatyakavisistan sanatvaniti vacyanityata aha– yokEkatesa iti yatva– nivrtakarnana eva cnanopayatvena yokatvat tyakasanatvayo tatekatesatvat katan sanatvan? artat krhita(sanka)tyakatvayoka ityuktirityato va pakavatpakterapi yokatvatva aha– yokEkatesa iti 48
s: भावदीपः पूर्वेणैवेति ‘इच्छा च तस्य युक्ता’ इत्यादिग्रन्थेनैवेत्यर्थः ‘यतः’ इत्याद्यागमसत्वेपि तस्य प्रत्येकमेव योगविशेषणे व्यावर्तके इत्यर्थ

pk: Bavadipa yogaya yujyasva ityuktaniti jnanopayaya prayatasvetyuktanityarTa atra tu ‘durena’ iti sloke tatrEva jnanopayaya prayatasva ityuktarTa eva kanyakarnata sesarupan kanyasya nindarupan va hetvantaranityarTa sasWisanasa eva kuto na? ityata aha– purusarTa-sanbanDineti ‘upayat’ ityatrakanksan purayati– purusarTasyeti tadupayayogeti niskanakarnanusWanetyarTa 49 srisunatindratirTaviracita

ck: pavatipa ata evetiti ‘lokavilaksanakriyavatvateva’ ityartasya spastatvat evakarartanaha– evasapteneti ‘yucyate’ ityatyuktan vyanakti– civananiti aksepa iti caturvarnyan tvaya srstan cet tarhi kartrtvat civavat tavapi karnalepa prasacyeta ityarcunakrtaksepa kinasraya? kin trstantanasritya pravartate? yena ‘tasya’ ityatyutarartena pariharo katatetyarta nanvisvarasya kriyanan nityatvacnanatalepa, civasya tu tatapavalepa iti sankate– cnaneneti lepa iti civasya nityatvacnanalepe sati nivaranan ca vyartan opartan nityatvacnanasyEva sanpatyatvatityarta hetuhetunatoriti ‘akartaran’ ityanenapi-nivesapavarupaheto ‘na nan karnani linpanti’ ityanena satyasya coktatvatityarta

pk: Bavadipa karnakarane iti saptanyantan uktatvaditi ‘inan vivasvate’ (4.1) ityadineti Bava ‘iti nan’ ityadi purvaslokotararDanuvada– yadityadi ata eveti jnanitvasya vivaksitatvadevetyarTa tasya vivaksayan tu karnakaranepi ‘aniyana sarvesan’ (bra.su.3.3.32) iti sutroktadisa nuktisidDe ‘karna krtvEva’ iti karnakarana-niyanoktirna syaditi Bava ‘karna krtva’ ityuktya kaTan jnanitvavivaksalaBa ityata aha– nahiti ‘yena karna krtvEva iti niyanoktirGaweta’ iti vakyasesa yadva jnanikrtanapi jnanadvarastu nuktihetu kutoDikanuktihetutvakalpanetyata aha– nahiti hisabdenananda-vrdDihetutve prananaprasidDan sucayati nanvevan gitayan ‘anandavrdDikanE’ iti vaktavyan na ‘nunuksuBi’ ityata aha– tatsa-Dukarinyupratyaya iti trtiyasya dvitiyapade ‘akve tacCilatadDarnatatsaDukarisu’ (pa.su.3.2.13) ityaDikare ‘sanasansaBiksa u’ (pa.su.3.2.68) iti sutrena sanantasya saDukari ityarTe ‘u’ pratyayokteratra ‘saDunoksecCakariBi’ ityarTe upratyaya ityarTa saDutvanca satisayatvaneveti Bava purvaniveti tatsajatiyaniti Bava ata eveti ksanikatvasucanena sajatiyagrahanarTatva-devetyarTa 15
ck: pavatipa karnakarane iti saptanyantan uktatvatiti ‘inan vivasvate’ (4.1) ityatineti pava ‘iti nan’ ityati purvaslokotarartanuvata– yatityati ata eveti cnanitvasya vivaksitatvatevetyarta tasya vivaksayan tu karnakaranepi ‘aniyana sarvesan’ (pra.su.3.3.32) iti sutroktatisa nuktisite ‘karna krtvEva’ iti karnakarana-niyanoktirna syatiti pava ‘karna krtva’ ityuktya katan cnanitvavivaksalapa ityata aha– nahiti ‘yena karna krtvEva iti niyanoktirkateta’ iti vakyasesa yatva cnanikrtanapi cnanatvarastu nuktihetu kutotikanuktihetutvakalpanetyata aha– nahiti hisaptenananta-vrtihetutve prananaprasitan sucayati nanvevan kitayan ‘anantavrtikanE’ iti vaktavyan na ‘nunuksupi’ ityata aha– tatsa-tukarinyupratyaya iti trtiyasya tvitiyapate ‘akve tacilatatarnatatsatukarisu’ (pa.su.3.2.13) ityatikare ‘sanasansapiksa u’ (pa.su.3.2.68) iti sutrena sanantasya satukari ityarte ‘u’ pratyayokteratra ‘satunoksecakaripi’ ityarte upratyaya ityarta satutvanca satisayatvaneveti pava purvaniveti tatsacatiyaniti pava ata eveti ksanikatvasucanena sacatiyakrahanartatva-tevetyarta 15

pk: Bavadipa priyaditvaditi ‘striya punvadBasitapunskadanunsananaDikarane striyanapurani priyadisu’ iti (pa.su.6.3.34) sasWatrtiyapadiyasutrenoktasasWapunskat parasya anunga stripratyayasya punvadrupan syat ekarTe strilinge parata, na tu puranyan priyadO parata’ iti punvadBavasya priyadO parato niseDat; Baktipadasya priyadO paWadityarTa ‘eka Bakti yasya’ ityuktavapi ‘ekatadDite ca’ (pa.su.6.3.62) iti tatpadagatasutrena ‘tadDitante utarapade ca parata ekasabdasya hrasvo Bavati’ ityukte ‘ekaBakti’ iti rupasidDavapi vaksyananapranananuroDad vyaDikaranabahuvrihirapyarasrita iti jneyan taTapiti ekasabdasya pulingatvopapatavapityarTa ‘anekananyapadarTe’ (pa.su.2.2.24) iti sananaDikaranananeva bahuvrihyukteriti Bava bahuvrihitvaKyapanayaha– ityupaskartavyaniti anyaTa ‘sa ucyate’ ityuktyanupapateriti Bava 17
ck: pavatipa priyatitvatiti ‘striya punvatpasitapunskatanunsananatikarane striyanapurani priyatisu’ iti (pa.su.6.3.34) sastatrtiyapatiyasutrenoktasastapunskat parasya anunka stripratyayasya punvatrupan syat ekarte strilinke parata, na tu puranyan priyatO parata’ iti punvatpavasya priyatO parato nisetat; paktipatasya priyatO patatityarta ‘eka pakti yasya’ ityuktavapi ‘ekatatite ca’ (pa.su.6.3.62) iti tatpatakatasutrena ‘tatitante utarapate ca parata ekasaptasya hrasvo pavati’ ityukte ‘ekapakti’ iti rupasitavapi vaksyananapranananurotat vyatikaranapahuvrihirapyarasrita iti cneyan tatapiti ekasaptasya pulinkatvopapatavapityarta ‘anekananyapatarte’ (pa.su.2.2.24) iti sananatikaranananeva pahuvrihyukteriti pava pahuvrihitvakyapanayaha– ityupaskartavyaniti anyata ‘sa ucyate’ ityuktyanupapateriti pava 17
s: भावदीपः प्रियादित्वादिति ‘स्त्रियाः पुंवद्भाषितपुंस्कादनूङ्समानाधिकरणे स्त्रियामपूरणी प्रियादिषु’ इति (पा.सू.६.३.३४) षष्ठतृतीयपादीयसूत्रेणोक

s: भावदीपः प्रतिपाद्यभेदेनाध्यायभेदमाशङ्क्य भगवदुपासनोत्तमतैव प्राधान्येन प्रतिपाद्यते तदुपायस्तु तादर्थ्येन अतो नानेेन दोष इति भावेनाऽह–तदुपाय

pk: Bavadipa udahrtavakyeti ‘sriyan vasana’ ityadisrutityarTa ‘Darnasya nana padaBanga’ ityanvaya iti praTanaskanDe vrsaBarupaDarnasya pariksitasca sanvadarupe saptadaseDyaye ‘kovrscatava padanstrin sOraBeya catuspada’ iti pariksitkrtaprasnan prati ekapadasTitavrsarupo Darno utaranuktavan ‘dEvananye pare karna svaBavanapare praBun apratarkyat’ ityadina tatra pancanyantasya sakanksatvat Darnasya nana padaBanga iti sesoktya slokenvayo boDya ityarTa ‘dEvan’ ityadivakyepyakanksan sesoktya purayati padaBange-tyadi sacCabdarTasyEvakasavayurupasyEva srutavukterasacCabdarTan svayanaha tejoebBulaksana-niti asanBavaditi anutpadyananadityarTa
ck: pavatipa utahrtavakyeti ‘sriyan vasana’ ityatisrutityarta ‘tarnasya nana patapanka’ ityanvaya iti pratanaskante vrsaparupatarnasya pariksitasca sanvatarupe saptatasetyaye ‘kovrscatava patanstrin sOrapeya catuspata’ iti pariksitkrtaprasnan prati ekapatastitavrsarupo tarno utaranuktavan ‘tEvananye pare karna svapavanapare prapun apratarkyat’ ityatina tatra pancanyantasya sakanksatvat tarnasya nana patapanka iti sesoktya slokenvayo potya ityarta ‘tEvan’ ityativakyepyakanksan sesoktya purayati patapanke-tyati sacaptartasyEvakasavayurupasyEva srutavukterasacaptartan svayanaha tecoepulaksana-niti asanpavatiti anutpatyananatityarta

pk: Bavadipa evasabda kevalarTa ityaha– eveti kevalaniti Dyanan vina krtanityarTa upapatiti jnanapurvaByasat kevalajnanasya, sadDyanajnanat kevala-Dyanasya sreyastvayogarupopapatya ajnanapurvad aByasadajnanan kevalajnanat sajnanaDyanan sreya ityarTo labDa ityupapatya labDanityuktan anyaTa iti Basyanuvada,DyanadaDikye sati iti vyaKya prakrtopayogaya anudyarTanaha– karnasanyasaditi vaksyananeti utararDe vaksyananan yatkarnaviragatyagaKyan sarvan tatoDikanityarTa aPalakanksan ityanena tyagapadena va ekarTanirasayaha– viraga iti
ck: pavatipa evasapta kevalarta ityaha– eveti kevalaniti tyanan vina krtanityarta upapatiti cnanapurvapyasat kevalacnanasya, satyanacnanat kevala-tyanasya sreyastvayokarupopapatya acnanapurvat apyasatacnanan kevalacnanat sacnanatyanan sreya ityarto lapta ityupapatya laptanityuktan anyata iti pasyanuvata,tyanatatikye sati iti vyakya prakrtopayokaya anutyartanaha– karnasanyasatiti vaksyananeti utararte vaksyananan yatkarnavirakatyakakyan sarvan tatotikanityarta apalakanksan ityanena tyakapatena va ekartanirasayaha– viraka iti
s: भावदीपः एवशब्दः केवलार्थ इत्याह– एवेति केवलमिति ध्यानं विना कृतमित्यर्थः उपपत्तीति ज्ञानपूर्वाभ्यासात् केवलज्ञानस्य, सद्ध्यानज्ञानात् केवल-ध

pk: Bavadipa kriyaprabanDa iti trtiyaDyayatrtiyapade ‘nanadyatanavat kriyaprabanDasanipyayo’ iti sutran tasyarTa– Butanadyatane Bavisyadanadyatane ca lanlrwO vivaksitO tayo pratiseDa kriyate anadyatane ca pratyayaviDirna Bavati kriyaprabanDe sanipye ca ganyanane kriyanan prabanDakriya kriyaprabanDa satatyenanusWanan kalanan, sanipyan tulyajatiyenavyavaDanan yavajivan Badranananadat, yavajivan Brta anan dasyati, yavajivan yukta aDyapipat, yavajivan yukto aDyapayisyati sanipye tu ‘yeyan pOrnanasyatikranta tasyanagninadaDita ‘sonenayaswa sa grananadadaDipataye yananavasyaganina etasya yaksyati asangan dasyati upaDyaya agnina dasyati sonena agnina aDite ityadinyudaharanani adyatanavat kriyaprabanDasanipyayorityeva vaktavye nanadyatanavaditi ceti dvO pratiseDO praptasyapyanujnanayetyuktan ‘ButaBavisyanadyatanavat pratyayO na Bavata’ ityuktya adyatane lawa apratiseDat kriyaprabanDe laqityuktan taTa ca hrsyatiti santataharsavan ityarTo Bavatiti Bava apavyaKyan ‘hrsyati’ ityuktya adyatano hi isvara upasakanan iti
ck: pavatipa kriyaprapanta iti trtiyatyayatrtiyapate ‘nanatyatanavat kriyaprapantasanipyayo’ iti sutran tasyarta– putanatyatane pavisyatanatyatane ca lanlrtO vivaksitO tayo pratiseta kriyate anatyatane ca pratyayavitirna pavati kriyaprapante sanipye ca kanyanane kriyanan prapantakriya kriyaprapanta satatyenanustanan kalanan, sanipyan tulyacatiyenavyavatanan yavacivan patranananatat, yavacivan prta anan tasyati, yavacivan yukta atyapipat, yavacivan yukto atyapayisyati sanipye tu ‘yeyan pOrnanasyatikranta tasyanakninatatita ‘sonenayasta sa krananatatatipataye yananavasyakanina etasya yaksyati asankan tasyati upatyaya aknina tasyati sonena aknina atite ityatinyutaharanani atyatanavat kriyaprapantasanipyayorityeva vaktavye nanatyatanavatiti ceti tvO pratisetO praptasyapyanucnanayetyuktan ‘putapavisyanatyatanavat pratyayO na pavata’ ityuktya atyatane lata apratisetat kriyaprapante latityuktan tata ca hrsyatiti santataharsavan ityarto pavatiti pava apavyakyan ‘hrsyati’ ityuktya atyatano hi isvara upasakanan iti
s: भावदीपः क्रियाप्रबन्ध इति तृतीयाध्यायतृतीयपादे ‘नानद्यतनवत् क्रियाप्रबन्धसामीप्ययोः’ इति सूत्रम् तस्यार्थः– भूतानद्यतने भविष्यदनद्यतने च लङ्

pk: Bavadipa nanu jnananeva Bagavadvisayakan sansaranasakan natu ‘ye tu sarvani’ ityadina praguktan Bagavati sarvakarnasanarpanadikan tatkaTanucyate idan sarvakarnasanyasanadikan Darnavisayananrtan ceti ata aha tadupasanangatvaditi yo praBavasca’ iti vaktunityadi Basyadiseti Bava (Bavadi prakrtyorgatisunyatve parinanonuKatvadirupapravrtistu sanBava-titi Bava ) pravrtasyeti kanyakarnano BagavadarpanaderasanBavad anrtahetutvaBavacetyarTa nivrtasyeti niskanakarnano harsanarsadisaDanatvena tatsaDyananeva praguktataya tesaneva atredanpadena grahyatvaditi Bava adipadatatparyanaha –anrtasabdasceti ‘suKaduKa’ ityadibanDasyopalaksaka ityarTa ityupasargatveneti vartike upasargatvena sangrhyananasyapi astikyarupavastuvacitvanarTa upasargatvokte ‘pragDato’ iti sutrena vihitaprakprayogadi-rupakaryavisesanatrarTatvena upasargavadasatvavacitvaBavad vyarTan na Bavatiti satvavacitva-navirudDanityarTa iti srinatsuDindratirTapujyapadasisyasriraGavendrayativiracite srinadgitaBasyawikaBavadipe dvadasoDyaya 12
ck: pavatipa nanu cnananeva pakavatvisayakan sansaranasakan natu ‘ye tu sarvani’ ityatina prakuktan pakavati sarvakarnasanarpanatikan tatkatanucyate itan sarvakarnasanyasanatikan tarnavisayananrtan ceti ata aha tatupasanankatvatiti yo prapavasca’ iti vaktunityati pasyatiseti pava (pavati prakrtyorkatisunyatve parinanonukatvatirupapravrtistu sanpava-titi pava ) pravrtasyeti kanyakarnano pakavatarpanaterasanpavat anrtahetutvapavacetyarta nivrtasyeti niskanakarnano harsanarsatisatanatvena tatsatyananeva prakuktataya tesaneva atretanpatena krahyatvatiti pava atipatatatparyanaha –anrtasaptasceti ‘sukatuka’ ityatipantasyopalaksaka ityarta ityupasarkatveneti vartike upasarkatvena sankrhyananasyapi astikyarupavastuvacitvanarta upasarkatvokte ‘praktato’ iti sutrena vihitaprakprayokati-rupakaryavisesanatrartatvena upasarkavatasatvavacitvapavat vyartan na pavatiti satvavacitva-navirutanityarta iti srinatsutintratirtapucyapatasisyasrirakaventrayativiracite srinatkitapasyatikapavatipe tvatasotyaya 12
s: भावदीपः ननु ज्ञानमेव भगवद्विषयकं संसारनाशकम् नतु ‘ये तु सर्वाणि’ इत्यादिना प्रागुक्तं भगवति सर्वकर्मसमर्पणादिकम् तत्कथमुच्यते इदं सर्वकर्मसन

s: भावदीपः पुरुषतत्वमिति तज्जीवेश्वरस्वरूपमित्यर्थः पिण्डीकरणेति विविच्य प्रदर्शनकार्यतया ततः पूर्वभावित्वायोगादाह– गौणोऽत्र क्त्वाप्रत्यय इति

pk: Bavadipa ineriti ‘ata iniWanO’ iti natvarTe vihita ‘ini’-pratyayasya vEyarTyaditi Bava ityanena gatarTatvaditi vikarasabditakaryavatvasya yadvikaripadena praptatvat ‘tat ksetran’ ityanudya ‘anutpadyate’ ityanenapi karyavatvasyEva praptya ‘utpadyate’ iti kriyaDyaharacetyarTa nanu vikaransca gunanscEva vidDi prakrtisanBavan ityagre satvadigunanan karyatve punvikaranan prTagukterihapi uktavyatyasena pOnaruktyanityata aha– ityasyanyaTopapateriti ‘tesanatyalpopi viseso layatsarga’ iti visesokti nanvevan pratijnavakyanuktananitvadisaDanokti,‘anadinatparan brahna’ iti jneyokti ‘yajnatva anrtanasnute’ iti praptyuktisca agretana kaTan syat? ityata aha ananitva-niti naca ‘yo yatpraBavasca’iti vaktun ’ityadiBasyadiseti Bava nanu jnananeva Bagavadvisayakan sansaranasakan ca, natu? ‘ye tu sarvani’ ityadina praguktan Bavati ino laqadesasatrantasyeti ‘ino yan’ iti yanadese ‘yat’ iti rupan yatereva rupatve ‘yat’ iti syaditi Bava gatyaBavaditi prakrtyade gatisunyatvepi parinano-nuKatvadirupapravrtistu sanBavatiti Bava
ck: pavatipa ineriti ‘ata initanO’ iti natvarte vihita ‘ini’-pratyayasya vEyartyatiti pava ityanena katartatvatiti vikarasaptitakaryavatvasya yatvikaripatena praptatvat ‘tat ksetran’ ityanutya ‘anutpatyate’ ityanenapi karyavatvasyEva praptya ‘utpatyate’ iti kriyatyaharacetyarta nanu vikaransca kunanscEva viti prakrtisanpavan ityakre satvatikunanan karyatve punvikaranan prtakukterihapi uktavyatyasena pOnaruktyanityata aha– ityasyanyatopapateriti ‘tesanatyalpopi viseso layatsarka’ iti visesokti nanvevan praticnavakyanuktananitvatisatanokti,‘anatinatparan prahna’ iti cneyokti ‘yacnatva anrtanasnute’ iti praptyuktisca akretana katan syat? ityata aha ananitva-niti naca ‘yo yatprapavasca’iti vaktun ’ityatipasyatiseti pava nanu cnananeva pakavatvisayakan sansaranasakan ca, natu? ‘ye tu sarvani’ ityatina prakuktan pavati ino latatesasatrantasyeti ‘ino yan’ iti yanatese ‘yat’ iti rupan yatereva rupatve ‘yat’ iti syatiti pava katyapavatiti prakrtyate katisunyatvepi parinano-nukatvatirupapravrtistu sanpavatiti pava
s: भावदीपः इनेरिति ‘अत इनिठनौ’ इति मत्वर्थे विहित ‘इनि’-प्रत्ययस्य वैय्यर्थ्यादिति भावः इत्यनेन गतार्थत्वादिति विकारशब्दितकार्यवत्वस्य यद्विकार

ck: pavatipa svarupan ceti ‘paran prahna’ iti prahnasvarupan ‘sa ca ya’ iti praticnatanityarta prapavanantaraniti ‘anatinat’ ityati ‘upapatyeta’ ityanta-krantantaranityarta aneneti ‘prakrtin purusan ca’ ityatinetyarta prakrtyatiti kata-niti ‘nahaputani’ ityatina prakrtyateranekasyecativikaranan coektatvat purusapate-nesvarascet sopi ‘anatinatparan prahna’ iti prakukta eveti pava ‘yatrk ca’ iti praticnatoktiparatvalapayaha– saprakaranirupayatiti prakrti-purusayoranatitvarupan satvatinan sarkakalinalpipavatprakrtisanpavatvarupan icativikaranan pahutvaprakrtisanpavatvarupan prakaran nirupayatityarta ityeke anye tu prakrte karyakarana-kartrtvahetutvarupan, purusasya poktrtvarupan, kunanan satasatyonikananacanakaranatvarupan prakaran nirupayatityarta ityahu
